Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators unable to access essential payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-stock-photos-without-paypal-explained-digital-creators-5|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-9|The Full]]. This situation forces talented individuals to either abandon their ideas or resort to makeshift solutions that compromise their business. This guide provides a straightforward approach to establishing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to sell digital products directly and securely using cryptocurrency. You will discover how to set up your own store and process payments seamlessly, ensuring that your creations reach your audience without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Many creators in Kenya are familiar with the frustration of being locked out of conventional payment solutions. This infrastructure works because it is built for sovereignty. By leveraging tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you develop a system that does not depend on third-party platforms. With a fully operational online store, you regain control over your products and data. Unlike traditional platforms that can freeze accounts or reject transactions without notice, this infrastructure is resilient. You own everything after deployment, ensuring your business remains operational even when others fail. This approach empowers creators, allowing them to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and more without worrying about currency restrictions or platform limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital storefront, ensure you have the essential components in place. Start by defining the digital products you intend to sell, whether they are ebooks, music beats, or design templates. Next, you’ll need a reliable hosting platform. Options like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are free and provide an excellent foundation for your online store. Additionally, set up a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Understand the cryptocurrencies you will accept and ensure your audience is familiar with them. Finally, consider how you will deliver your products. Utilizing tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for digital file storage is effective and cost-efficient. By preparing these components, you set yourself up for a smooth deployment process and ensure a successful launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a seamless payment and delivery pipeline, begin by integrating NOWPayments into your online store. This involves configuring the payment options on your platform and ensuring that customers can easily select their desired cryptocurrency. After setting up payment processing, focus on automating product delivery. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to create a backend logic that triggers the automatic delivery of your digital products upon successful payment confirmation. This means once a customer completes a purchase, they receive an email with the download link or automatic file delivery through your chosen storage solution. By automating this process, you enhance the customer experience, minimize manual intervention, and streamline your operations. Ensure thorough testing to confirm that your pipeline works flawlessly before going live.
Empower your digital business without relying on traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it’s time to go live. Announce your launch to your audience through social media and other marketing channels. Monitor your platform closely as your first transactions come in. When a customer makes a purchase, check the NOWPayments dashboard for transaction confirmation. This dashboard provides real-time insights into your sales, allowing you to track performance effectively. Ensure that the email delivery system is functioning correctly, sending buyers their download links immediately after payment confirmation. As you process your first transactions, gather feedback to identify any potential issues and improve the customer experience. Quick troubleshooting in the early stages can help refine your systems and build a solid foundation for future transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your store and processing initial transactions, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Analyze customer feedback and transaction data to understand your audience better and identify opportunities for growth. You can expand your product offerings by introducing new digital products or bundles that cater to your existing customer base. Utilize social media marketing to increase visibility and attract more customers. As you grow, assess the backend infrastructure to ensure it handles increased traffic and transactions. Tools like Supabase can be integrated for more advanced data management. Lastly, explore partnerships with other creators or platforms to broaden your reach. By continuously optimizing and scaling your operations, you can ensure long-term success without being dependent on external payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To start selling digital products with cryptocurrency, deploy your own commerce infrastructure using tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for payment processing, and Google Drive for file delivery. This setup allows you to bypass conventional payment platforms entirely, ensuring full control and ownership over your digital products. You can find a complete guide with resources in the Complete Builder Kit for $197. This kit provides all necessary blueprints and templates for a successful launch.
Achieve full ownership and control of your commerce infrastructure.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Define the digital products you will sell, ensuring they meet market demand. 2. Choose a hosting platform (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages) for your online store. 3. Set up NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. 4. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage and delivery automation. 5. Integrate backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automatic product delivery. 6. Test the entire process from payment to delivery thoroughly. 7. Launch your store and promote it through social media and marketing channels. 8. Collect feedback for further improvements and scaling opportunities.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments. Choose the ones that your target audience is most familiar with, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoins.
How do I ensure secure transactions?
Using NOWPayments ensures secure transactions, as it operates on blockchain technology providing transaction transparency and tamper-proof records. Additionally, ensure your website uses HTTPS.
What if I want to sell physical products later?
This infrastructure can also be adapted for physical products. Simply integrate a shipping solution and adjust your order processing pipeline accordingly.
Can I customize my storefront design?
Absolutely. With GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you can customize your storefront’s design using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create a unique brand experience.
How will I handle customer support?
Set up a dedicated email or support ticket system to address customer inquiries and issues. Provide a FAQ section on your site to help customers find answers quickly.
